joint_campaign_decision: HOLD remains immutable; joint A/B promotion is not recommended.

per_role_rule.exact_text: Execute the pre-output candidate/baseline evaluation rubric and promote only the passing role-specific candidates through adoption evidence references. Own evaluation fixtures, actual experiment outputs and adoption metadata; no selector, capability, launcher or maintenance algorithm changes.

- Promote only roles satisfying every frozen rubric criterion in both repetitions with no material baseline regression. Failed candidates remain update candidates with retained results; any new experiment versions inputs instead of erasing failures. Existing verified current candidates may remain eligible.

impl-reviewer-a.recommendation: Eligible for bounded human consideration only; not adopted.

impl-reviewer-b.recommendation: Withhold. First failed t04 evidence claim and legitimate extra Major findings retained.

material_baseline_regression: No adopted incumbent or comparison arm; not measured. First-role qualification is bounded and does not claim superiority.
